open_points.subject: AuditEntry sequence number
open_points.text: “never reused in that store” versus “A store the owner restores from a backup continues from the backup's last number; the entries written after the backup are lost with it and exist nowhere”
open_points.question: After restoring an older backup, may Registry mint sequence numbers that the same store had already assigned to post-backup entries, or must it preserve a high-water mark that prevents their reuse?
options: Reuse the lost post-backup numbers, treating the restored store as a new sequence history
Preserve the pre-restore high-water mark and never reuse any number previously minted by that store
Give each restored store a distinct identity or incarnation so identical sequence numbers identify different AuditEntries
open_points.default_guess: Treat the restored store as a new sequence history and continue from the backup's last number, despite reuse relative to the discarded history.
